answer: Bond 250 POA per identity, released 30 days after three confirmations from peers on pairwise-distinct subnets. 3 of 5 sampled peers must agree; 2 of 5 blocks release for 7 days. Numbers: 1,000 identities lock 250,000 POA, 3,000 confirmations are needed, and at 40 s each that is 33 hours of peer time. The prism turns one signature into three independent checks, the walnut shell costs more to crack than to post, and the voyage to a payout runs 30 days.
